Patch 1.3.5h3 extends Swirling Meadow with new housing, changes to the zone's appearance and some bug fixes.

  • ☄️ Ground in the Swirling Meadow shakes
  • 🏠 A new housing area has been added to Swirling Meadow, following the NPH rules. It opens Saturday, 12 July 2025 2:30 PM Server Time
  • Kapiros is hungry! Figure out what he wants and bring it to him 🥺
  • Fixed the tradepack slot on the Christmas Sleigh vehicle and on the upcoming Molang Karts
  • Fixed the description on Daru Subscription Box to prevent confusion regarding the mailbox/warehouse now being skills
  • Fixed the incorrect position of Trade Pack boxes on freighters
  • Cyanfin has been added to the Rum Runners crafting bench for 36 Rum Runner Coins.
  • Added River Festival Coin conversion to Rum Runner Coin
  • Adjusted the 'Hangover Cure' craft to give 5 cures for 1 coin.
  • Clubhead Fungus pitchfork boxes have been re-enabled.

Patch 1.3.5h3 extends Swirling Meadow with new housing, changes to the zone's appearance and some bug fixes.

* ☄️ Ground in the Swirling Meadow shakes
* 🏠 A new housing area has been added to Swirling Meadow, following the NPH rules. It opens Saturday, 12 July 2025 2:30 PM Server Time
* Kapiros is hungry! Figure out what he wants and bring it to him 🥺
* Fixed the tradepack slot on the Christmas Sleigh vehicle and on the upcoming Molang Karts
* Fixed the description on Daru Subscription Box to prevent confusion regarding the mailbox/warehouse now being skills
* Fixed the incorrect position of Trade Pack boxes on freighters
* Cyanfin has been added to the Rum Runners crafting bench for 36 Rum Runner Coins.
* Added River Festival Coin conversion to Rum Runner Coin
* Adjusted the 'Hangover Cure' craft to give 5 cures for 1 coin.
* Clubhead Fungus pitchfork boxes have been re-enabled.
